sentences.japanese: そんな事は、彼にとっては赤子の手を捻るようなものだ。
sentences.english: For him, that will be like taking candy from a baby.

sentences.japanese: 彼をやり込めるくらい、赤子の手を捻るより簡単だよ。
sentences.english: Cornering him in an argument is easy—like taking candy from a baby.

sentences.japanese: 「ふむ」 武田先生は口ひげを捻りながらうなった。
sentences.english: "Hrmm," mumbled Professor Takeda as he twisted his moustache.

sentences.japanese: いくら頭を捻ろうがそんな名前は出てこなかった。
sentences.english: No matter how I racked my brain, I couldn't remember that name.

sentences.japanese: 体を捻ってから下までしゃがみます。
sentences.english: After twisting your body, squat down.
